subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own an automated same-product archive import/restore command, or should core stay limited to safer backup export, platform conversion, verification, and manual restore guidance?
rationale: The choice determines the CLI namespace, archive trust boundary, destructive write policy, secret/session portability rules, and whether overlapping backup and migration PRs can proceed in core.

options.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
options.body: Define a preview-first core import/export lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and security tests before implementation.

options.title: Prefer Backup Convert And Manual Restore
options.body: Keep automated restore out of core for now and improve backup output, platform targeting, verification, and user-facing migration docs.

options.title: Split Optional Pieces To Plugins
options.body: Keep core focused on missing APIs while ClawHub or plugin packages own cloud, scheduled, encrypted, or workspace-specific migration flows.

recommendation.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
recommendation.body: Define a preview-first core import/export lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and security tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The related implementation discussion already centered on their restore security-boundary concern, and their history is closest to backup verification/path-safety decisions.
